title: Browser watchlist
description: The watchlist kept in localStorage under "vf.watch.v1" (src/lib/watch/store.js), and the Export file (same items). Nothing is stored on a server.

items.description: Watched releases by release key (12 hex, src/lib/search/release-key.js)

t.description: Title shown in the list (from the card watched, or an event)

u.description: Link to the copy that was watched, or from an event

o.description: The copy that was watched: [priceCents, currency, shop name]

a.description: Day it was added, YYYY-MM-DD; events before it are ignored

s.description: Last known state [inStock, soldOut, minPriceCents, currency]

f.description: Day it was found in stock again after being out of stock, YYYY-MM-DD (the New label)

x.description: Other release keys found by its catalog number (listings titled differently)

n.description: Release keys marked as not this record

m.description: Max price, euro cents: copies above it are not shown

w.description: Discogs release id, for wants imported from a Discogs wantlist

last.description: Newest data date (from /w/index.json) whose events were applied

day.description: UTC day of the last check (at most one per day)

refreshed.description: UTC day the watch page last loaded current states

changes.description: Unseen changes: event rows of /w/d/<date>.json plus their date

fresh.description: Records added since the watch page was last opened (the tab shows +n)

hinted.description: 1 once the home-screen hint was shown

visit.description: UTC day the watch page was last opened: records found since are New
